```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'tooling/typescript-config/**'
      - 'packages/**/tsconfig.json'
      - 'apps/**/tsconfig.json'
      - 'CODEOWNERS'
      - 'scripts/tsconfig-future-audit.mjs'

permissions:
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tsconfig audit
        run: node scripts/tsconfig-future-audit.mjs

      - name: Extract code owners
        id: codeowners
        run: |
          owners=$(awk '/^[^#]/ {for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) print $i}' CODEOWNERS | sort -u | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')
          echo "CODEOWNERS=$owners" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Request review from code owners
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          CODEOWNERS: ${{ env.CODEOWNERS }}
        with:
          script: |
            const reviewers = process.env.CODEOWNERS.split(',').filter(Boolean);
            if (reviewers.length > 0) {
              await github.pulls.requestReviewers({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                pull_number: context.issue.number,
                reviewers: reviewers
              });
            }
```
